adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `EmbedController#best` enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` on every request when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil, with no throttle/guard at enqueue time. `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` reloads the page every 30s, so clients will repeatedly hit `embed#best` and enqueue repeated jobs until the embed exists. The only throttling shown is inside `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` (Redis `setnx` + 60s expiry), which prevents repeated fetches but does not prevent Sidekiq queue/job churn. This is a concrete performance/queue-pressure concern introduced by the diff, not a functional correctness defect per se.
